{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; asked questions on load-time checks and derivation format that author addressed"
    },
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept NACKish; objects to Parse returning strings and wallet storing multipath records instead of reconstructing from descriptor objects"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3905364971",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "Multiple multipath descriptors sharing an expanded descriptor causes ambiguous/arbitrary mapping",
      "quote": "<0;1> and <0;2> are different policies that share their /0/* expansion, so one descriptor can sit in two records and this hands back whichever the map reaches first.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3905999298",
        "rc:3907144679"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3907144679",
      "settled_by_quote": "This is now prevented."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3905364980",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "Failed write on setup leaves wallet created reporting success without storing the multipath record",
      "quote": "Dropped here, a failed write leaves the wallet created and reporting success with no record, and the transaction wrapping wallet setup never learns of it.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3907145945"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3907145945",
      "settled_by_quote": "Added the missing handling and a [[nodiscard]]."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3905364989",
      "kind": "interface",
      "harm": "Inconsistent hardened derivation marker representation ('h' vs ''') between desc and multipath",
      "quote": "The origin comes through as typed here when the key is an xpub, and normalized when it's the xprv, so desc and multipath can end up disagreeing on 84h versus 84' for the same key.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3907148929"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "rc:3907148929",
      "settled_by_quote": "Good catch, fixed multipath normalization to always uses h."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5503486189",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "Storing multipath descriptor strings and making Parse return strings instead of reconstructing multipath from descriptor objects is the wrong architecture",
      "quote": "My suggestion was not to store an extra record, but rather an extra field in WalletDescriptor which contains the ids of the other descriptors in the multipath. Reconstructing the multipath can be done by doing a pairwise traversal in Descriptor::ToString()",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5508760340",
        "c:5676525474"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5079561909",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Supports the approach of storing multipath descriptor records in the wallet",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial assessment. achow101 raised a blocking Concept NACKish over the approach of storing multipath strings in the wallet database and having Parse produce strings, preferring traversing descriptor objects on the fly; the author engaged and marked the PR as draft awaiting further conceptual review."
}

participants.note: Concept ACK; asked questions on load-time checks and derivation format that author addressed
Concept NACKish; objects to Parse returning strings and wallet storing multipath records instead of reconstructing from descriptor objects

claims.harm: Multiple multipath descriptors sharing an expanded descriptor causes ambiguous/arbitrary mapping
claims.quote: <0;1> and <0;2> are different policies that share their /0/* expansion, so one descriptor can sit in two records and this hands back whichever the map reaches first.

claims.harm: Failed write on setup leaves wallet created reporting success without storing the multipath record
claims.quote: Dropped here, a failed write leaves the wallet created and reporting success with no record, and the transaction wrapping wallet setup never learns of it.
claims.settled_by_quote: Added the missing handling and a [[nodiscard]].

claims.harm: Inconsistent hardened derivation marker representation ('h' vs ''') between desc and multipath
claims.quote: The origin comes through as typed here when the key is an xpub, and normalized when it's the xprv, so desc and multipath can end up disagreeing on 84h versus 84' for the same key.
claims.settled_by_quote: Good catch, fixed multipath normalization to always uses h.

claims.harm: Storing multipath descriptor strings and making Parse return strings instead of reconstructing multipath from descriptor objects is the wrong architecture
claims.quote: My suggestion was not to store an extra record, but rather an extra field in WalletDescriptor which contains the ids of the other descriptors in the multipath. Reconstructing the multipath can be done by doing a pairwise traversal in Descriptor::ToString()

support.reason: Supports the approach of storing multipath descriptor records in the wallet

result.notes: Initial assessment. achow101 raised a blocking Concept NACKish over the approach of storing multipath strings in the wallet database and having Parse produce strings, preferring traversing descriptor objects on the fly; the author engaged and marked the PR as draft awaiting further conceptual review.

changes: claim c:5503486189 added (open, blocking) by achow101
